title: gaultheria buxifolia var. elassantha
intro: Gaultheria buxifolia var. elassantha, commonly known as Mountain Pepper, is a plant species in the heath family (Ericaceae). It is used in traditional medicine to provide relief from various health issues, including digestive problems, fever, and respiratory ailments, due to its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Mountain Pepper include analgesic, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant effects, which contribute to its potential health benefits. The bioactive constituents of Gaultheria buxifolia var. elassantha include polyphenolic compounds, essential oils, and organic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
